entries.name: File System MCP Server
entries.description: Provides file system read/write/search tools. Requires a directory argument to bound the scope.

entries.name: Git MCP Server
entries.description: Exposes git operations (status, diff, log, commit, branch) as MCP tools.

entries.name: GitHub MCP Server
entries.description: Access GitHub repositories, issues, PRs, and actions via MCP. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var.

entries.name: Fetch MCP Server
entries.description: Web content fetching and conversion to markdown. Useful for documentation lookup.

entries.name: SQLite MCP Server
entries.description: Query and modify SQLite databases via MCP. Useful for project-level data inspection.

entries.name: Playwright MCP Server
entries.description: Browser automation via Playwright. Useful for E2E testing and web scraping.
